wang2025computational occurrences:
<HOME> strongest evidence supports a conditional process--structure--conductivity relation in LLZO. Dopants and lithium inventory alter phase stability and carrier occupancy; precursor route and green-body history set the reaction length scale; thermal treatment, cover and crucible determine lithium retention, density and grain-boundary chemistry; and these states control how bulk, boundary and total resistance appear in impedance. Rapid sintering, membranes and interface layers expand the processing window, but their benefits remain conditional on measured phase fraction, relative density, surface chemistry, contact pressure and a named transport protocol \cite{anderson2024comprehensive,heywood2023tailoring,moy2025irreversible,yao2026elimination,zhang2024unveiling,klimpel2023standardizing}. A complete LLZO phase diagram and a universal route ranking are not established by the present evidence; the transferable result is the minimum comparison record.
<HOME> highest-value next experiments are therefore the three discriminating designs described above: first, map lithium-addition order, cover state and compact thickness with assay-corrected high-temperature diffraction; second, test Ta--LLZO grain-boundary chemistry at matched density with calibrated microscopy and a standardized critical-current protocol; third, quantify and remove the ultrafast-sintered surface layer using paired sister specimens. These experiments can be scheduled independently, and each has a clear failure criterion. Together they offer the fastest route to deciding whether a reported conductivity gain arises from phase stabilization, densification, boundary chemistry or simply a change in measurement conditions.
<HOME> transport is a hierarchy of local hopping, grain interiors, grain boundaries and electrode interfaces. A high total conductivity can arise from a genuinely mobile bulk phase, from a low-resistance boundary network, or from an impedance fit that assigns a contact contribution to the electrolyte. Atomistic--mesoscale calculations and grain-boundary measurements both show why the same nominal composition can yield different resistance partitions \cite{heo2021microstructural,gao2021revealing,kulkarni2025machine}.
<HOME> mechanistic vocabulary is supported by direct diffusion, structural and modeling studies. Lithium self-diffusion NMR, garnet transport calculations, Raman-informed molecular dynamics and machine-learning-assisted trajectories probe different time and length scales, so agreement among them is stronger than any single descriptor alone \cite{kuhn2011li,kozinsky2015effects,wang2015design,miyagawa2026raman,burov2026machine,wang2025computational,jin2023garnet}. Measurements on Ta garnets and phosphate ceramics reinforce the need to distinguish local mobility from the resistance of a complete microstructure \cite{ahmad2015concentration,mariappan2011correlation,aono1993the}.
<HOME> reported experiments support five bounded conclusions. First, sintering additives or lithium-containing transient phases can increase densification and lower resistance, but the additive may remain at boundaries or change the phase assemblage \cite{janani2014influence,luo2019influence,park2026li2co3}. Second, lithium and other elements can diffuse irreversibly during firing, so the compact composition after sintering is not necessarily the weighed composition \cite{moy2025irreversible,gullbrekken2025phase}. Third, rapid microwave or laser schedules can shorten thermal exposure and produce dense LLZO or LLZTO, but they create larger thermal gradients and surface-chemistry contrasts than a conventional furnace \cite{aman2026susceptor,ramos2026ultrafast,zhang2024unveiling}. Fourth, crucible material and cover configuration are chemically active boundary conditions; Pt or Al crucibles should be recorded rather than treated as interchangeable hardware \cite{k2026influence}. Fifth, grain-boundary segregation is not an immutable property of the garnet lattice: co-doping, atmosphere and thermal path can remove or create boundary-rich regions \cite{ahmad2025reducing,golmohammad2024effects,yao2026elimination}.
<HOME> one-step Al--N doping, temperature-window and transformation-toughening studies broaden the thermal evidence while retaining the same caveat: density, phase assemblage and surface chemistry must be measured together \cite{zhang2026al,qin2026influence,lessmeier2026transformation}. Earlier reactive-sintering and lithium-oxide-additive work reaches high density through transient liquids or enhanced particle contact, providing useful process precedents without proving a universal additive mechanism for every LLZO composition \cite{li2020solid,li2013influence,jonson2018tape,zhang2022high}.
<HOME> same density--microstructure coupling appears in hot pressing, spark-plasma and cold-sintering literature. Grain-boundary state, local pore evolution and the applied current or pressure can change shrinkage and mechanical constraint independently of nominal composition \cite{ni2012room,srivastav2020localized,srivastav2020microstructure,orru2009consolidation,galotta2021the,cai2023microstructure}. These are processing analogues, not LLZO conductivity values, and they motivate reporting the green-body density and the spatial distribution of residual porosity.
<HOME> sheets, bilayer dense--porous membranes and ultrafast-sintered self-standing LLZO demonstrate that the process--structure relation changes when thickness falls below a conventional pellet scale \cite{gao2019preparation,ye2020water,zhang2023bilayer,zhang2023ultrafast,touidjine2026tapex}. Drying stress, binder burnout and in-plane shrinkage can produce gradients that are invisible in a single polished cross-section. Membrane reports should therefore include thickness maps, areal density, bending or handling history and the electrode area used for impedance.
<HOME> diffraction and multielement-loss studies show that lithium inventory, exposed thickness and processing path can change phase evolution and final composition \cite{gullbrekken2025phase,montoya2024lithium,moy2025irreversible}. The proposed test is a blocked $2\times2\times2$ interaction screen for Al--LLZO that varies lithium-addition order, compact thickness and cover state at a fixed nominal excess, followed by a smaller excess-lithium grid for the two strongest interactions. Every condition receives high-temperature or operando diffraction, density and a sister-specimen Li/Al/La/Zr assay; conductivity is compared only after density normalization. The decision rule is a reproducible cubic phase fraction, assay-corrected lithium retention and a conductivity change that survives furnace-block adjustment.
<HOME> and boundary-engineering studies suggest that a lower grain-boundary resistance can reflect a changed boundary composition rather than a more conductive garnet bulk \cite{ahmad2025reducing,golmohammad2024effects,du2024constructing,yao2026elimination}. A Ta--LLZO pilot should reproduce the Li$_2$CO$_3$ versus LiOH precursor comparison while selecting two furnace schedules that reach matched relative-density bands. Cross-sectional STEM--EDS/EELS, or a calibrated ToF--SIMS fallback, is required to quantify boundary composition or thickness; impedance and a standardized CCD test are then performed on the same density bands \cite{bae2026effect,klimpel2023standardizing}. The hypothesis is supported only if one calibrated boundary descriptor predicts both grain-boundary resistance and CCD after density and furnace block are included.
<HOME> spectroscopy identifies a Li$_2$O-rich surface layer in ultrafast-sintered LLZO, while thermal cleaning and membrane studies show that surface chemistry depends on atmosphere and post-heat treatment \cite{zhang2024unveiling,zhang2023on,zhang2023ultrafast,shi2025li2co3}. The proposed paired-sister design compares ultrafast and conventional sintering with 0, 1 and 2 h post-heating near the reported 900~$^{\circ}$C mitigation condition. One sister is reserved for as-sintered electrochemistry, one for depth chemistry and lithium assay, one for post-heat chemistry, and one for post-heat electrochemistry. XPS depth profiles, FIB--ToF--SIMS, carbonate spectroscopy, phase analysis and density are combined with the standardized CCD protocol \cite{klimpel2023standardizing}. Cleaning is considered beneficial only when the surface signal decreases, lithium retention and cubic phase are preserved, and the paired interface resistance or CCD improves.
<HOME> same local precursor ranking used for Al--LLZO favors oxide/carbonate mixtures, but it does not predict the thickness or chemistry of the post-sinter surface layer. Those quantities require direct depth calibration and an inert-transfer control.
<HOME> oxide or carbonate mixing remains the reference route because precursor identities and mass balances are easy to audit. A comparative Al--LLZO study found that solid-state and sol--gel routes can yield different thermal, structural and electrochemical responses even at nominally similar composition \cite{kosir2022comparative}. Reaction-pathway-informed synthesis further shows that a short calcination can be effective when precursor availability and intermediate phases are controlled, rather than when dwell time is simply reduced \cite{garman2025reaction}. These findings favor a route description that records milling media, order of addition, solvent or binder, calcination atmosphere, intermediate phase and the reason for selecting the dwell time.
<HOME> is commonly discussed as a garnet framework with lithium distributed over partially occupied sites. The useful distinction for processing is not simply “cubic” versus “tetragonal,” but the combination of symmetry, lithium occupancy, dopant distribution and hydration history. Reviews and structure studies describe aliovalent substitution as a way to change both the lithium count and the configurational disorder that stabilizes a highly conducting state \cite{cao2019modeling,raju2021crystal,kim2020research}.
<HOME> measurement vocabulary is shared with broader oxide-electrolyte and battery studies, but the transfer is methodological rather than numerical. Reviews of inorganic conductors, garnet/polymer composites and all-solid-state interfaces emphasize that conductivity, mechanical constraint and interfacial stability must be reported on the same specimen \cite{ohno2020materials,abakumov2020solid,reddy2020sulfide,li2020status,guo2022solid,ma2023a,he2024solid}. Computational descriptors are likewise useful only when their length scale and boundary conditions are stated; LLTO calculations are a comparator and not LLZO evidence \cite{wang2025computational,li2024machine,burov2026machine}.
<HOME> thermodynamic language also requires care. High-temperature studies resolve phase evolution and lithium volatilization for selected Al- or Nb-containing compositions, while a complete LLZO composition--temperature--oxygen-potential diagram is not reported in the present corpus \cite{gullbrekken2025phase,montoya2024lithium,luo2025phase,li2026structure}. We therefore refer to a local phase relation or measured phase sequence when evidence exists, and identify measurement of a composition-resolved phase diagram as an open experiment rather than inferring a universal phase boundary.
<HOME> determines which lithium sites are occupied, which framework sites are substituted and how much lithium is available during firing. Early LLZO studies established that Al, Ga, Ta, Nb, Y and related substitutions can stabilize a cubic-like garnet state or alter the tetragonal--cubic transition, but the concentration that maximizes conductivity is route-dependent \cite{puente2021garnet,raju2021crystal,anderson2024comprehensive,aote2023enhancement,siddiqui2024increased}. A composition label is therefore a starting hypothesis, not a guarantee of phase or carrier concentration.
<HOME> LLZO illustrates the coupled problem. High-temperature diffraction tracks phase evolution in Li$_{6.25}$Al$_{0.25}$La$_3$Zr$_2$O$_{12}$, and processing studies show that lithium volatilization changes the phase sequence as sample thickness and exposure geometry change \cite{gullbrekken2025phase,montoya2024lithium,heywood2023tailoring}. The practical implication is to report the lithium excess relative to the weighed batch, the covered area, the pellet thickness and the measured retained composition. A high conductivity measured after uncontrolled lithium loss cannot be assigned solely to the dopant.
<HOME> composition studies extend this picture across the dopant space. Ce substitution in Ga-doped LLZO, NbO$_2$-derived Nb substitution and Nb-doping studies each report coupled changes in lattice parameters, local electronic structure and electrochemical response \cite{aote2025impact,saran2026nbo2,yadzo2025improving}. Reports of Ga stabilization, simultaneous Y/Ta substitution and Al-free Ta phase stability similarly demonstrate that dopant valence and lithium inventory must be interpreted together \cite{wolfenstine2012synthesis,elshinawi2012stabilization,dhivya2014effect,thompson2014tetragonal}.
<HOME> literature supports a coupled rather than linear interpretation of LLZO processing. Lithium inventory affects phase formation and volatilization; the thermal path converts that inventory into a density and boundary state; the boundary state controls how the bulk response appears in impedance and how current is distributed at a Li interface. Reviews that separate “materials,” “processing” and “battery” sections are useful for navigation, but the same specimen-level variables cross those boundaries \cite{cao2019modeling,wang2020garnet,wang2024accelerating,zhao2024review}.
<HOME> each paper, the reader can reconstruct the following chain: precursor and lithium source $\rightarrow$ green density and thickness $\rightarrow$ calcination and sintering atmosphere $\rightarrow$ phase fraction and retained composition $\rightarrow$ density, grains and boundaries $\rightarrow$ bulk, boundary and total resistance $\rightarrow$ Li or cathode cell response. Missing links should be marked as not reported rather than silently inferred. This matrix operationalizes the minimum-record contribution and aligns with recent calls for scalable LLZO processing and standardized interface tests \cite{wang2024accelerating,touidjine2026tapex,klimpel2023standardizing}.
<HOME>  \caption{Coupled variables governing LLZO transport. Solid arrows show the main processing--structure--transport path; dashed arrows indicate interface and measurement feedbacks that constrain process design.}
<HOME> source set contains many title- and abstract-level records, while detailed conditions are available for only a subset. Consequently, the review does not pool conductivity values or fit a meta-analysis. Near-neighbor garnets establish mechanisms but are not used to rank LLZO. Computational studies identify plausible pathways and descriptors, yet their predictions remain model-dependent until validated on matched specimens \cite{miyagawa2026raman,kulkarni2025machine}. Finally, the available local phase relations do not replace a composition--temperature--lithium-activity diagram; that absence is a measurement priority, not evidence that no such relation exists.
<HOME>\fancyhead[L]{\small\itshape LLZO processing--structure--conductivity}
<HOME>\title{Processing--Structure--Conductivity Relations in LLZO Garnet Electrolytes: \\
<HOME> Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_2$O$_{12}$ (LLZO) is frequently compared through a single room-temperature conductivity value, although composition, lithium inventory, precursor chemistry, thermal history, microstructure and measurement geometry vary substantially between studies. This review organizes the literature as a process--structure--transport chain. We first define the phase, defect and resistance terms needed for a fair comparison, then follow powder synthesis through forming, densification, membranes, grain boundaries and Li or cathode interfaces. A minimum comparison record keeps nominal and retained composition, cover and crucible, relative density, microstructure, temperature, electrode geometry and fitting model together. The synthesis shows that lithium activity, boundary chemistry and surface exposure are coupled variables rather than independent optimization knobs; a complete LLZO phase diagram and a universal route ranking remain unavailable. Three executable experiments are proposed: a lithium-activity interaction map, a matched-density Ta--LLZO grain-boundary study, and a paired surface-cleaning test after ultrafast sintering. Precursor choices returned by a local model are labelled as model predictions, pending experimental validation, and are not chemical conclusions.
<HOME> lithium batteries require an electrolyte that combines rapid lithium-ion transport with mechanical integrity, chemical tolerance and a manufacturable form factor. Garnet-type Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_2$O$_{12}$ (LLZO) is attractive because its oxide framework supports a wide range of aliovalent substitutions and can be processed as dense ceramics, thin sheets or composite electrodes \cite{wang2020garnet,puente2021garnet,kim2020research}. Yet the name LLZO covers samples made with different lithium inventories, precursor chemistries, atmospheres, covers, crucibles, thermal ramps and impedance geometries. A conductivity number therefore cannot be interpreted without the material state and the route that produced it.
<HOME> review follows a process--structure--transport chain. It asks how composition and phase stability set the available lithium sites; how precursor chemistry and forming determine the green body; how thermal history and lithium activity set density and grain-boundary chemistry; and how those states are read by impedance, spectroscopy and cell tests. The resulting comparison is deliberately conditional: a route is considered transferable only when the composition, thermal history, relative density, microstructure and measurement definition are reported together. The framework extends the processing emphasis of recent LLZO reviews \cite{cao2019modeling,wang2024accelerating,zhao2024review,sazvar2025review} by making comparability itself an object of analysis.
<HOME> target phase is garnet-type LLZO and its Al-, Ta-, Ga-, Nb-, Y-, Sr- and related substituted variants. We include powder synthesis, calcination, forming, sintering, rapid or assisted densification, membranes, grain boundaries, environmental exposure, Li contacts and cathode integration. We use related garnets as mechanistic comparators, but do not transfer their conductivity values to LLZO. We also separate direct measurements from calculations and from nominal-composition assignments. Reviews provide vocabulary and route families, while primary studies anchor claims about processing or electrochemical response \cite{wang2020garnet,puente2021garnet,raju2021crystal,chen2022processing,wang2026research}.
<HOME> scope is also informed by a deliberately bounded oxide-ceramic analogy. In BaZn$_2$Si$_2$O$_7$, diffraction and thermal-expansion work resolves a temperature-triggered structural transition, while Ba/Sr substitution stabilizes a related high-temperature framework \cite{lin1999phase,thieme2015ba1}; combustion and crystal-growth studies show that precursor route and dopant choice change phase selection and luminescence \cite{yao2011synthesis,yao2011crystal}. Partial BaO--SrO--ZnO--SiO$_2$ and BaO--ZnO--SiO$_2$--B$_2$O$_3$ studies further illustrate how additive content and eutectic liquid formation can redirect phase assemblages \cite{thieme2018effect,chen2010phase}. Thermodynamic treatments of Y$_2$O$_3$--SiO$_2$, ZnO--SiO$_2$ and related oxide subsystems provide a methodological precedent for combining measured equilibria with CALPHAD extrapolation \cite{makrovets2023y2o3,shevchenko2019thermodynamic,konar2020a}. No exact Ba--Y--Zn--Si--O quaternary phase diagram or thermodynamic assessment was identified in the bounded corpus; these partial-system results therefore cannot establish Ba--Y--Zn--Si--O phase fields. The silicate papers are not LLZO measurements and do not establish LLZO phase fields or conductivity; they are used only to motivate an explicit workflow of phase-diagram measurement, composition spacing and thermodynamic modeling.
<HOME> focusing on LLZO, it is useful to state what neighboring garnets have already taught us. Li$_5$La$_3$Ta$_2$O$_{12}$ and other lithium-stuffed garnets show that cation substitution changes lithium concentration, site occupancy and the tetragonal--cubic transition, while pressure-assisted consolidation can alter density independently of composition \cite{zhao2018enhancement,cao2019modeling,puente2021garnet}. These results support a transferable principle: phase symmetry and carrier concentration are coupled, but neither predicts the measured total resistance without a microstructural descriptor.
<HOME> same family also demonstrates why processing details matter. Thin-sheet, water-based and self-standing membrane studies report dense garnet bodies at thermal budgets different from conventional LLZO firing, and their transport depends on thickness, residual porosity and electrode geometry \cite{gao2019preparation,ye2020water,zhang2023ultrafast}. Atomistic and microstructural studies further indicate that low-energy pathways can coexist with mechanically vulnerable interfaces \cite{heo2021microstructural,yu2018grain}. We therefore use neighboring garnets as evidence for mechanisms and reporting practices, not as a ranking of LLZO recipes.
<HOME> surveys and application-oriented studies converge on the same reporting problem: garnet composition, processing, interfaces and cell architecture are inseparable when a result is transferred across laboratories \cite{cheng2024li,kodgire2024review,han2023recent,liu2018challenges,jia2020comprehensive,li2020status,sun2022prospects,guo2022solid}. Recent processing guidance adds scale-up, environmental and manufacturing constraints to that comparison \cite{balaish2025emerging,touidjine2026tapex,jagan2026recent}. These sources frame the review, whereas the mechanistic claims below are tied to primary LLZO or explicitly marked comparator studies.
<HOME>\subsection{Li--LLZO contact and dendrites}
<HOME> cathodes expose the trade-off between ceramic connectivity and electrochemical contact. Infiltration into a porous or bilayer LLZO scaffold increases active-area access, while tape casting and co-sintering introduce shrinkage and chemical compatibility constraints \cite{zhang2023bilayer,finsterbusch2018high,go2026developing,touidjine2026tape,zubair2026high}. Ga substitution, lithium carbonate compensation and polymer incorporation can change cathode compatibility or low-temperature handling, but the resulting cell response includes both ionic transport and electrode reaction limitations \cite{roitzheim2026fully,lu2021modified,ren2022oxide,touidjine2024the,seo2020broad}.

# Review round 1 — final LLZO survey

## Verdict

**FAIL**. The review has two blockers and four major issues (I9–I14 in the
ledger). `review_pass` must remain `FAIL` until the blockers and majors are
resolved and the complete manuscript is independently reviewed again. This was
a cold-start same-model review: no `mcp__codex__codex` cross-model endpoint was
available in this session, so the independence requirement is explicitly
limited.

## Materials read

I independently read `drafts/main.tex`, all ten files in
`drafts/sections/`, `inputs/scope.md`, `notes/taxonomy.md`,
`notes/contribution.md`, `notes/figure_plan.md`, `state/CITATION_AUDIT.md`
and `.json`, the three SVG/Draw.io pairs, the three experiment plans and
proposal files, the coverage report, style notes/cards, and the ledger history.
No manuscript file was modified.

## PDF page-by-page audit

`drafts/main.pdf` was rasterized and visually inspected page 1, page 2, and
page 3. `pdfinfo` reports only 3 A4 pages; the metadata identifies a
“GoAI Research bounded survey-writer retry” fallback. The pages contain:

| Page | Observed content | Editorial result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Title, a statement that pdflatex is unavailable, a short abstract, and a statement that `main.tex` is authoritative | Not a typeset manuscript; no sections, citations, tables, or figures |
| 2 | A ten-item contents list and “Fig. 3 reserved” | Contents placeholder only; contradicts delivered fig3 assets |
| 3 | Quality-check prose and a warning that the fallback is not a substitute for journal typesetting | Explicit admission that the required PDF is absent |

This is blocker I9. A real compiled PDF is required before page-level table,
reference, caption, line-break, and figure-placement acceptance is possible.

## Claim–citation audit

Ten representative keys were extracted from factual claims and checked with
`verify_entry`; all ten metadata records passed (Wang 2020, Puente 2021, Kim
2020, Cao 2019, Wang 2024, Zhao 2024, Chen 2022, Garman 2025, Gullbrekken
2025, and Klimpel 2023). The audit also verified `k2026influence` (Pt/Al
crucibles) and `hong2024combined` (Li–La–Zr–O phase diagram) as real records.

The context check found blocker I10: `wang2025computational` is a verified
2025 ECS Meeting Abstracts paper on lithium lanthanum titanate (LLTO), not
LLZO. It is cited in `sections/06_transport_measurement.tex:4,28` and
`sections/08_discussion.tex:16` as if it were LLZO transport/model evidence.

or replaced with an LLZO source.

- **Near-neighbor systems:** `01_introduction.tex` has a real subsection on

  search found relevant BaZn2Si2O7 phase-transition/synthesis records, so this
  is a coverage omission rather than an unverifiable request.
- **Experimental conclusion bundle:** `05_densification_microstructure.tex`
  contains five bounded conclusions covering additives, irreversible Li loss,
  rapid heating, crucible/cover chemistry, and boundary segregation.
- **Phase diagram:** `02_background.tex` and `03_composition_phase.tex`
  distinguish local measured Li2O–La2O3–ZrO2 relations from the unavailable
  global composition–temperature–oxygen-potential diagram and propose a
  measurement rather than inventing a boundary.
- **Process + precursor recommendations:** `09_open_problems.tex` gives three
  process-level experimental designs and labels every local-model precursor
  output “model prediction, pending experimental validation”; the idea files
  also carry EHS/safety fields. These are appropriately not presented as
  chemical conclusions.
- **Roadmap:** Fig. 2 is present in source and its SVG/Draw.io pair is valid,
  but it cannot be judged in the supplied PDF because the PDF is the fallback.
- **Two-part conclusion:** `10_conclusion.tex` has two paragraphs: an
  evidence-weighted synthesis followed by prioritized discriminating experiments.
- **Pt/Au crucibles:** `k2026influence` was verified as a real Pt/Al LLZO
  study and is placed under thermal processing, not crystal growth. No Au
  crucible record was found in the retained bibliography; the manuscript does
  not make an unsupported Au claim.

## Figures and production checks

All three figspec files validate with `ok: true`, zero errors, and zero
typo-errors. All three SVGs and Draw.io files parse as XML; native Draw.io
files contain the expected vertices/connectors. Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 previews are
generally legible. Visual inspection of Fig. 3 found the right-hand
“MEASUREMENT COMPARABILITY” heading clipped at the canvas edge and the
`Li retention`/`thermal` edge labels crowding or clipping against group
boundaries (major I12). The manuscript also explicitly reserves Fig. 3 rather
than including it (major I11). Draw.io Desktop PNG export was unavailable on
the host, as recorded in `figure_plan.md`.

The manuscript’s organizing idea is coherent: composition, precursor history,
thermal/Li activity, microstructure, measurement, and interfaces are treated

| Thermal history → Li/LLZO interface stability (`thermal`) | direct | Thermal and surface history affect interphase/contact behavior; scope interface boundary and `cheng2024li`, `huo2019li`. |
| Li/LLZO interface stability → surface chemistry (`interface chemistry`) | direct | Interphase composition, contact resistance, and surface treatment are the stated interface descriptors; `cheng2024li`, `huo2019li`. |
| Reporting/uncertainty → comparability/process design (`uncertainty`) | direct | Scope asks which comparisons are invalid and what minimum reporting set enables reproducible scale-up; `li2020status`, `zhao2024review`. |

# LLZO 综述贡献声明与动机（阶段一草案）

> **状态：未经用户确认。** 本轮为自动运行；依据回环协议的不可达降级规则，以下候选声明暂作为后续组稿的工作假设，并在账本中记录“贡献声明未经用户确认”的 decision。用户若提出修改，应先更新本文件与 taxonomy，再进入下一阶段。

## 研究对象与证据边界

本综述聚焦石榴石型 Li₇La₃Zr₂O₁₂（LLZO）的制粉、成形、烧结/致密化，以及工艺—结构—Li⁺输运之间的可比关系。输入语料含 362 条记录，其中 357 条可映射至 `references.bib`；184 条在题名或摘要层面进入主 taxonomy。151 条记录缺少摘要、111 条摘要被截断，因此本阶段只确定阅读路径，不把题名/摘要级归类提升为机制结论或性能排序。相近 garnet 化合物被单列为参照，不把其数值直接移植到 LLZO。

## 候选贡献声明（供用户确认）

### 候选 A：工艺链 taxonomy

提出一个以“组成/相状态 → 粉体合成 → 热处理与致密化 → 成形与器件集成”为主轴的树形分类，并将微结构、表面化学和 Li/LLZO 界面作为材料状态与应用分支。该分类把原本分散的前驱体、锂损失、烧结边界条件和输运读出放进同一导航框架。

### 候选 B：最小可比性记录

建立跨论文比较前的最小实验记录：名义/实测组成与掺杂、前驱体和锂库存、混合与热历史、气氛/覆盖粉/坩埚/助剂、相组成与相对密度、晶粒/晶界描述，以及电导类型、温度、几何和电极配置。根据这些项目，将结果区分为可直接比较、只能定性并列、或证据不足，而不制作脱离测量条件的“最佳路线”排名。

### 候选 C：耦合变量与可检验问题图

把锂挥发/补锂、相稳定化、添加剂反应、晶界偏析、环境暴露和 Li 金属接触视为相互耦合的变量；对每个公开模式给出缺失证据、可证伪的下一步表征或实验，以及适用范围。该贡献把“低温/高电导”等标签转化为需要同时报告的工艺和结构条件。

### 当前自动运行采用的工作组合

暂采用 A+B+C 的组合，仅用于阶段二以后的章节规划；这不是用户对措辞或科学优先级的确认。若用户选择单一候选或重写动机，taxonomy 的分支名称和章节蓝图必须随之复核。

## Motivation

LLZO 文献常沿材料设计、制备、输运、界面和电池演示分别展开，但相同名义组成的样品仍可能使用不同前驱体、锂过量、混合方式、气氛、覆盖粉、坩埚、烧结程序、致密度和电导定义。若只按路线或掺杂元素罗列，工艺变量与结构读出之间的耦合会被隐藏，跨论文的性能差异也可能只是测量条件不一致。本文因此先建立可追溯的工艺链和结构分支，再用最小可比性记录约束比较，最后把未报告项目转化为可检验的问题。该动机与 style bank 归纳的“结构/组成 → 制备与掺杂 → 输运 → 界面/电池 → 挑战与展望”写作骨架一致。

## 预期读者收益

1. 研究者可由目标变量（相稳定、致密化、晶界、输运或界面）定位代表文献，而非逐篇浏览。
2. 实验结果可按统一项目报告，减少把颗粒电导、晶界电导和总电导混为一谈的风险。
3. 未来实验可优先裁决锂活度、晶界化学和界面接触等跨分支不确定性；任何模型或路线建议均需标明待实验验证。

## 确认停点记录

- 需要用户确认：候选 A/B/C 的取舍、综述是否强调制造放大或界面电池演示、以及“最小可比性记录”是否作为正式贡献。
- 自动运行处置：在用户不可达时保留上述候选并继续落盘；账本 decision 明确记录“贡献声明未经用户确认”，不伪称已获确认。

--- page 4 ---
Background and Definitions
LLZO is commonly discussed as a garnet framework with lithium distributed over partially occupied sites. The
useful distinction for processing is not simply “cubic” versus “tetragonal,” but the combination of symmetry,
lithium occupancy, dopant distribution and hydration history. Reviews and structure studies describe aliovalent
substitution as a way to change both the lithium count and the configurational disorder that stabilizes a highly
conducting state [4,8,3].
For a pellet of thickness L and electrode area A, the conductivity inferred from a resistance R is
Equation:
sigma = (L)/(RA).
The resistance may be fitted as a bulk term, a grain-boundary term and an electrode polarization term. A re-
ported “ionic conductivity” is therefore interpretable only when the fitted circuit, frequency range, electrode,
temperature and specimen geometry are given. Surface conditioning can change the apparent bulk response,
and proton exchange can change processing reproducibility, so cleaning and storage must be recorded along-
side impedance [39,40,41].
Temperature dependence is often summarized with an Arrhenius relation,
Equation:
sigma T = sigma_0 exp(-E_ak_BT),
where E_a is an apparent activation energy. A change in slope can indicate a phase transition, a change in dom-
inant resistance or a contact artifact; it should not be interpreted as a new hopping mechanism without inde-
pendent structural evidence. NMR, Raman and atomistic calculations provide complementary views of lithium
mobility, but they probe different length and time scales [42,43,44,26,45].
Relative density, open porosity and grain size are state variables rather than processing labels. Two samples
made with the same nominal composition can have different connected-pore fractions and boundary area after
pressing or sintering. Microstructure-aware modeling predicts that tortuosity and boundary resistance can dom-
inate the total response even when the local bulk diffusivity is unchanged [26,46,39]. Accordingly, this review
uses “bulk,” “grain boundary” and “total” only when the measurement separates them; otherwise the value is
reported as unspecified.
The measurement vocabulary is shared with broader oxide-electrolyte and battery studies, but the transfer is
methodological rather than numerical. Reviews of inorganic conductors, garnet/polymer composites and all-
solid-state interfaces emphasize that conductivity, mechanical constraint and interfacial stability must be re-
ported on the same specimen [47,48,49,33,35,50,51]. Computational descriptors are likewise useful only when
their length scale and boundary conditions are stated; LLTO calculations are a comparator and not LLZO evi-
dence [52,53,54].
Wet-chemical post-processing offers a further definition of state: structural modeling and spectroscopy show
that washing or hydration can alter lithium occupancy, surface phases and the apparent transport response
without changing the nominal formula [55,56].
Surface and environmental effects provide concrete examples of why the state variables are necessary. Thermal
cleaning, surface regeneration, ZnO coatings and carbonate-based exposure each modify the near-surface reac-
tion sequence, while air-stability studies show that particle size and dopant chemistry alter the rate of degrada-
tion [57,58,59,60,61,62,63].
The thermodynamic language also requires care. High-temperature studies resolve phase evolution and lithium
volatilization for selected Al- or Nb-containing compositions, while a complete LLZO composition--tempera-
ture--oxygen-potential diagram is not reported in the present corpus [64,65,66,67]. We therefore refer to a local
phase relation or measured phase sequence when evidence exists, and identify measurement of a composition-
resolved phase diagram as an open experiment rather than inferring a universal phase boundary.
 --- page 11 ---
Structure--Conductivity Relations and Measurement Comparability
LLZO transport is a hierarchy of local hopping, grain interiors, grain boundaries and electrode interfaces. A
high total conductivity can arise from a genuinely mobile bulk phase, from a low-resistance boundary network,
or from an impedance fit that assigns a contact contribution to the electrolyte. Atomistic--mesoscale calcula-
tions and grain-boundary measurements both show why the same nominal composition can yield different re-
sistance partitions [26,46,82].
The mechanistic vocabulary is supported by direct diffusion, structural and modeling studies. Lithium self-dif-
fusion NMR, garnet transport calculations, Raman-informed molecular dynamics and machine-learning-assist-
ed trajectories probe different time and length scales, so agreement among them is stronger than any single de-
scriptor alone [42,154,155,44,54,52,156]. Measurements on Ta garnets and phosphate ceramics reinforce the
need to distinguish local mobility from the resistance of a complete microstructure [157,158,159].

What can be compared directly?
Direct comparison is defensible when composition and phase state, relative density, temperature, sample thick-
ness, electrode area, electrode type and fitting circuit are matched. A qualitative comparison is still useful
when one of these items is missing, but the text should say which item limits inference. Surface conditioning,
air exposure and proton exchange are particularly important because they can change the near-surface chem-
istry without changing the bulk diffraction pattern [39,40,41].
Electrochemical-impedance reviews and critical-current studies make the protocol dependence explicit: equiv-
alent-circuit choice, pressure, electrode preparation and the failure criterion can reorder apparent performance
even for identical pellets [160,161,21,162]. Data-driven property prediction is most useful when it is paired
with these specimen-level descriptors, rather than when a model is trained on unqualified conductivity num-
bers [53,163,164,165].
Table:
Figure/Table caption: Minimum reporting set for a cross-paper conductivity comparison.
Measurement item | Why it changes the result | Preferred report | If missing
Phase and composition | Lithium occupancy and secondary phases alter carriers and blocking regions | Ri-
etveld phase fraction, dopant amount and retained Li | Qualitative only [68,67]
Density and microstructure | Pores and boundaries add tortuosity and resistance | Relative density, open
porosity, grain size and boundary description | Do not rank routes [26,46]
Temperature and geometry | Conductivity and apparent activation energy depend on both | Temperature
sweep, thickness, area and pressure | Values remain condition-specific [39,45]
Equivalent circuit and electrodes | Bulk, boundary and contact terms can be interchanged by fitting choice |
Circuit, frequency range, electrode and residuals | Report total response only [21,6]

Transport descriptors
The most useful bridge between structure and transport is a set of descriptors that can be measured on the same
specimen: phase fraction, retained lithium, relative density, grain-size distribution, boundary composition or
thickness, and the separated bulk and boundary resistances. Raman signatures and molecular-dynamics calcu-
lations can test whether a change in the vibrational spectrum is consistent with a change in lithium dynamics,
but they should not be used to replace an electrochemical measurement [44,82,45].
Critical-current-density (CCD) data require an additional protocol. Current density depends on electrode area,
stack pressure, temperature, plating/stripping schedule, voltage criterion and the definition of failure. A stan-
dardized measurement proposal for lithium garnets highlights that changing any of these parameters can re-
order apparent limits [21,162]. Consequently, a pellet conductivity and a symmetric-cell CCD should be pre-
sented as complementary outcomes, not as interchangeable performance scores.
 --- page 12 ---
Reconciling apparent contradictions
When two studies disagree, the first diagnostic is a comparison of density, temperature and resistance partition.
The second is surface and boundary chemistry: carbonate, hydroxide or a transient glass can lower or raise the
measured boundary term without changing the garnet lattice parameter. The third is lithium inventory and ther-
mal history, which can shift phase fraction and defect concentration. This order of checks keeps an apparent
materials contradiction from being attributed prematurely to a dopant or a new transport mechanism
[109,166,74,67].

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""bib_guard —— 稿件引用一致性确定性闸门（离线，无网络）。

检查项：
1. 正文 \\cite{key} / [@key] 引用的 key 是否都在 .bib 中定义（未定义 = 阻塞）
2. 库内条目整合率：被正文引用的 bib 条目 / bib 总条目，低于线 = 阻塞
   （孤儿条目要么在正文找到落点，要么移出库，不许留着充数）
3. 引用密度（综述质检：正文引用过少给告警）
   密度统计只应覆盖正文章节文件（如 workspace/drafts/sections），
   蓝图、修订日志等过程文档不要计入词数分母。
4. bib 字段卫生（告警）：doi 与 url 同存（编译后 URL 断行难看且冗余，
   应删 url 留 doi）；title 中化学式/多大写缩写未加 {} 保护
   （plainnat 会把 BaZn2Si2O7 压成 bazn 2 si 2 o 7）。

用法：
  python3 tools/bib_guard.py <draft_dir_or_file> <references.bib> \
      [--min-cites-per-1k 8] [--min-integration 0.9]
退出码：0 = PASS；1 = 存在未定义引用或整合率不达标。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import glob
import os
import re
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from server.core.bibtex import parse_bibtex  # noqa: E402

CITE_TEX = re.compile(r"\\cite[tp]?\*?(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}")
CITE_MD = re.compile(r"\[@([A-Za-z0-9_:\-]+)(?:[;,\s]+@?[A-Za-z0-9_:\-]+)*\]")
CITE_MD_EACH = re.compile(r"@([A-Za-z0-9_:\-]+)")
# title 里需要 {} 保护的 token：≥2 个大写字母 + ≥1 个数字（化学式/缩写），
# 或全大写缩写词（≥3 字母）。plainnat 等样式会把未保护 token 压成小写。
RE_PROTECT_NEEDED = re.compile(
    r"\b(?=\w*[A-Z]\w*[A-Z])(?=\w*\d)[\w()\[\]+.\-]*[A-Za-z0-9]|\b[A-Z]{3,}\b")


def bib_hygiene(entries: list[dict]) -> list[str]:
    """bib 字段卫生检查 → 告警清单（不阻塞）。"""
    warns: list[str] = []
    for e in entries:
        fields = e.get("fields", {})
        key = e["key"]
        if fields.get("doi") and fields.get("url"):
            warns.append(f"{key}: doi 与 url 同存——删 url 留 doi"
                         "（正文已链接 DOI，长 URL 编译后断行难看）")
        title = fields.get("title", "")
        # 去掉已被 {} 保护的片段后再扫
        unprotected = re.sub(r"\{[^{}]*\}", " ", title)
        hits = sorted({m.group(0) for m in
                       RE_PROTECT_NEEDED.finditer(unprotected)})
        if hits:
            warns.append(f"{key}: title 含未保护 token {hits[:4]}——"
                         "加 {{}} 防止 bibliography 样式压成小写"
                         "（化学式会被拆成 bazn 2 si 2 o 7 这种碎片）")
    return warns


def collect_cites(path: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
    """→ [(key, file, line_no)]。全文扫描：\cite{...} 参数允许跨行。"""
    out = []
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        text = f.read()
    line_starts = [0]
    for i, ch in enumerate(text):
        if ch == "\n":
            line_starts.append(i + 1)

    def line_of(pos: int) -> int:
        import bisect
        return bisect.bisect_right(line_starts, pos)

    for m in CITE_TEX.finditer(text):
        ln = line_of(m.start())
        for key in m.group(1).split(","):
            key = key.strip()
            if key:
                out.append((key, path, ln))
    for m in CITE_MD.finditer(text):
        ln = line_of(m.start())
        for km in CITE_MD_EACH.finditer(m.group(0)):
            out.append((km.group(1), path, ln))
    return out


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("draft", help="稿件目录或单个 .tex/.md 文件")
    ap.add_argument("bib", help="references.bib")
    ap.add_argument("--min-cites-per-1k", type=float, default=8.0,
                    help="每千词最低引用数（综述密度告警线）")
    ap.add_argument("--min-integration", type=float, default=0.9,
                    help="库内条目整合率下限（被引条目/bib 总条目，低于线阻塞）")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    files = ([args.draft] if os.path.isfile(args.draft) else
             sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(args.draft, "**", "*.tex"),
                              recursive=True)
                    + glob.glob(os.path.join(args.draft, "**", "*.md"),
                                recursive=True)))
    if not files:
        sys.exit(f"未找到稿件文件: {args.draft}")
    if not os.path.isfile(args.bib):
        sys.exit(f"未找到 bib 文件: {args.bib}")

    with open(args.bib, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        bib_entries = parse_bibtex(f.read())
    bib_keys = {e["key"] for e in bib_entries}

    cites: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    word_count = 0
    for fp in files:
        cites.extend(collect_cites(fp))
        with open(fp, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            word_count += len(re.findall(r"[\w\u4e00-\u9fff]+", f.read()))

    used = {c[0] for c in cites}
    undefined = sorted(used - bib_keys)
    orphans = sorted(bib_keys - used)
    density = len(cites) / max(word_count / 1000, 1e-9)
    integration = (len(bib_keys) - len(orphans)) / max(len(bib_keys), 1)

    print(f"稿件文件: {len(files)}  引用调用: {len(cites)}  去重 key: {len(used)}")
    print(f"bib 条目: {len(bib_keys)}  整合率: {integration:.0%}  "
          f"引用密度: {density:.1f} 次/千词")
    if undefined:
        print(f"\n[阻塞] {len(undefined)} 个未定义引用 key:")
        for k in undefined:
            locs = [f"{os.path.basename(f)}:{ln}" for kk, f, ln in cites if kk == k][:3]
            print(f"  - {k}  ({', '.join(locs)})")
    integration_fail = bib_keys and integration < args.min_integration
    if orphans:
        level = "阻塞" if integration_fail else "告警"
        print(f"\n[{level}] {len(orphans)} 个孤儿 bib 条目（未被引用），"
              f"整合率 {integration:.0%} vs 下限 {args.min_integration:.0%}:")
        for k in orphans[:20]:
            print(f"  - {k}")
    if density < args.min_cites_per_1k:
        print(f"\n[告警] 引用密度 {density:.1f} 低于线 {args.min_cites_per_1k}"
              "（综述通常需要更密的证据支撑）")
    hygiene = bib_hygiene(bib_entries)
    if hygiene:
        print(f"\n[告警] {len(hygiene)} 项 bib 字段卫生问题:")
        for h in hygiene[:30]:
            print(f"  - {h}")
    failed = bool(undefined) or bool(integration_fail)
    reasons = ([f"{len(undefined)} 个未定义引用"] if undefined else []) + \
              ([f"整合率 {integration:.0%} 低于 {args.min_integration:.0%}"]
               if integration_fail else [])
    print("\n结论:", f"FAIL（{'；'.join(reasons)}）" if failed else "PASS")
    sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Processing--Structure--Conductivity Relations in LLZO
Garnet Electrolytes: Synthesis, Densification, Interfaces,
            and Measurement Comparability
                                        GoAI Research Working Group
                                                     September 2026

Garnet-type Li_7La_3Zr_2O_12 (LLZO) is frequently compared through a single room-temperature conductivity value,
although composition, lithium inventory, precursor chemistry, thermal history, microstructure and measurement geometry
vary substantially between studies. This review organizes the literature as a process--structure--transport chain. We first
define the phase, defect and resistance terms needed for a fair comparison, then follow powder synthesis through forming,
densification, membranes, grain boundaries and Li or cathode interfaces. A minimum comparison record keeps nominal
and retained composition, cover and crucible, relative density, microstructure, temperature, electrode geometry and fitting
model together. The synthesis shows that lithium activity, boundary chemistry and surface exposure are coupled variables
rather than independent optimization knobs; a complete LLZO phase diagram and a universal route ranking remain un-
available. Three executable experiments are proposed: a lithium-activity interaction map, a matched-density Ta--LLZO
grain-boundary study, and a paired surface-cleaning test after ultrafast sintering. Precursor choices returned by a local
model are labelled as model predictions, pending experimental validation, and are not chemical conclusions.

Fallback typeset with groff and Ghostscript because pdflatex/xelatex is unavailable. The TeX source and sec-
tion files remain authoritative; this PDF preserves the complete manuscript text, captions, equations, tables and
cited bibliography.

# LLZO garnet 固态电解质：写作风格卡

本卡只提炼句式、结构和证据组织方式，不复述任何一篇综述的论点。每条观察都标注 exemplar id；`core` 13 篇，因专题综述数量不足而用 15 篇 `adjacent` 和 2 篇 `method` 补足。

## 1. 证据与样本概况

|指标|观测|来源|
|---|---|---|
|专题骨架|13/30 篇直接讨论 LLZO/garnet；常见主线是结构/相稳定性 → 合成与致密化 → Li⁺输运 → 电极界面 → 电池演示 → 挑战/展望|W3015452587, W2797994582, W3202407852, W2922914774, W3037554945, W3045616169, W3155282454, W3011658338, W1983411059, W4309484953, W4381742819|
|全文样本|11 个 PDF 文件；10 个可抽取文本（8 篇综述 + 1 篇跨材料综述 + 1 篇方法论文），另 1 个 Springer PDF 可读性异常|puente2021, cao2019, kim2020, cao2014, yao2019, feng2021, reddy2020, butenko2026, schwietert2019, zhao2019, yang2023 文件；对应 W3202407852, W2922914774, W3037554945, W2024048721, W2957014459, W3119230409, W3049304483, 2604.17380, 10.1038/s41563-019-0576-0, W2967943101, W4361218022|
|篇幅/图表|可读样本中位数约 17 页；专题长综述 40–46 页，短综述 10–19 页。图数量约 1–29/篇，表格 0–11/篇；高图密度通常用于材料族 taxonomy 或机理示意|W3202407852, W2922914774, W3037554945, W2024048721, W2957014459, W3119230409, 2604.17380|
|引用密度|长综述通常每页约 15–25 个编号引用；短综述用 1–3 个引用支撑一个段落或表格行|W3202407852, W2922914774, W2957014459, W3037554945|

## 2. 结构骨架卡（出现频次）

从可读全文和 OpenAlex 摘要中的章节信号归纳：

1. **引言 → 基础/结构 → 制备/掺杂 → 输运/性能 → 界面与电池 → 挑战/展望**（专题篇中约 8/13）：W3015452587, W2797994582, W3202407852, W2922914774, W3037554945, W3045616169, W4309484953, W4381742819。
2. **材料族 taxonomy → 结构–性质机制 → 工程策略 → 应用**（跨材料综述约 7/15）：W2808260231, W2024048721, W2967943101, W3049304483, W4293238043, W3003014070, W3092309741。
3. **复合/界面专线：组分与制备 → 离子传导 → 机械/化学稳定 → 电极接触 → 失效模式**（复合与界面综述约 7/15）：W3011658338, W3155282454, W2957014459, W3119230409, W4361218022, W4318616036, W4392914257, W4404473565。

**推荐给 LLZO 工艺综述的众数骨架**：

`问题与指标定义 → LLZO 晶体/缺陷基础 → 粉体合成与成形 → 烧结/致密化–微结构 → Li⁺输运与电导测量 → Li/LLZO 与正极界面 → 电池级验证 → 可制造性挑战与展望`。

## 3. 开题句式卡（仅句式参照）

以下为每篇不超过 25 个词的短引文，只用于模仿句式结构，禁止在正文照抄：

- “The development of all-solid-state batteries has placed solid electrolytes at the center of materials design …” —— 先给系统趋势，再落到材料核心变量（2604.17380）。
- “Li ion batteries … were commercialized in 1991 and have been developed to realize higher energy density …” —— 时间节点 + 性能驱动 + 研究转折（W3037554945）。
- “To meet the increasing energy demand, more efficient and safer electrochemical energy storage has become a hot spot …” —— 需求压力 → 研究热点 → 材料切入（W2922914774）。
- “From the moment in 1991 when … commercialization of lithium-ion batteries …” —— 历史里程碑开头，随后转入技术瓶颈（W2957014459）。

可复用的抽象模板：

1. “随着 **应用/安全/能量密度** 要求提高，**关键材料变量** 成为限制因素；本文按 **结构—工艺—性能** 展开。”（W3015452587, W2797994582）
2. “尽管 LLZO 具有 **高电导/宽窗口/对锂稳定**，但 **致密化、晶界或界面** 仍限制实用化；下文比较解决路径。”（W3202407852, W3037554945）
3. “现有工作多优化单一指标；本文把 **组成、微结构和接触条件** 放入同一因果链。”（W2922914774, W3045616169）

## 4. Branch 节写法

- **Topic sentence**：先给结论性属性，再限定变量（例如“Ta/Al/Ga 掺杂稳定立方相，但过量掺杂增加缺陷散射”），随后按“机制 → 代表性数据 → 局限”三句展开（W2922914774, W3202407852）。
- **分支顺序**：先按材料/工艺类别分组，再在每组内按时间或性能递进；避免逐篇流水账（W3037554945, W3015452587）。
- **引用密度**：每个机制段落约 3–8 个引用；表格中每一行至少有一个文献锚点，关键数值同时标出测量温度和致密度（W3202407852, W2922914774）。
- **对比表列设计**：`composition/dopant | synthesis route | sintering temperature | relative density | σLi+ (temperature) | activation energy | interface note | reference` 是最常见组合（W2922914774, W3202407852, W3184314335）。
- **加工—结构—性能桥接**：用一段话明确“粉体/成形参数 → 晶粒、孔隙、晶界 → 电导/临界电流密度”，而非把工艺与性能分离（W2795226759, W4381742819, W2922914774）。

## 5. Open problems / Outlook 写法

- **逐条式（约 8/13 专题篇）**：用编号或短小小标题列出空气敏感、Li 润湿、枝晶/临界电流、正极复合和规模化烧结；每条接一个证据锚点（W2797994582, W3037554945, W3202407852）。
- **叙事式（跨材料综述）**：先总结共性矛盾，再按“材料设计—界面工程—制造与验证”递进，结尾提出可检验指标（W2808260231, W2967943101, W4293238043）。
- **推荐组合**：LLZO 专题采用编号列表；每条包含“瓶颈 → 可测指标 → 优先实验/建模动作 → 适用边界”，避免空泛的“需要进一步研究”（W3045616169, W4309484953）。

## 6. 量化基准（供 writer/bank_check）

- 目标篇幅：核心综述 20–35 页，短综述 10–18 页；本主题草稿建议 18–25 页（W3202407852, W2922914774, W3037554945）。
- 图表预算：每 10 页约 3–6 个图/表；至少 1 张总览 taxonomy、1 张工艺–微结构–电导框架图、1 张界面失效图（W3202407852, W3037554945, W2957014459）。
- 引用预算：平均 15–25 篇/页；核心机制段落 3–8 篇/段，综述表格每行 1 个锚点（W3202407852, W2922914774, W2957014459）。
- 数值口径：电导须同时写温度、样品几何/致密度和测试方法；避免把室温颗粒电导与高温总电导直接比较（W2922914774, W3202407852, W4381742819）。

## 7. 禁用模式

- 不把 perspective/editorial 当作完整综述证据；W3007447726 仅作为挑战段落的结构参考。
- 不将跨材料综述中的聚合物/硫化物数值移植为 LLZO 数值（W2808260231, W3049304483）。
- 不把本卡中的短引文或范图复制进交付稿；它们只用于句式和视觉语法训练（2604.17380, W3037554945, W2922914774, W2957014459）。

# LLZO garnet 固态电解质：图形风格卡

图形观察来自 4 张范图（`exemplar_figures/`）及可读全文中的图注/页面统计；范图只作版权参照，不进入综述交付物。

## 1. 代表性范图索引

|文件|出处|图型与用途|视觉观察|
|---|---|---|---|
|`cao2019_fig-001.png`|W2922914774, p.2 附近|晶格/位点示意（Li1/Li2/Li3）|黑色骨架线 + 粉/黄/绿三类球；标签用细箭头，留白充足。|
|`kim2020_fig-000.png`|W3037554945, p.3 附近|三维 garnet 结构 + Li⁺迁移路径|结构渲染与平面路径并置，红/蓝/紫/绿用于区分元素和迁移。|
|`puente2021_fig-004.png`|W3202407852, p.5 附近|复合正极微结构对比|黄颗粒与浅蓝液相置于黑色边框，左右对照，图例简短。|
|`yao2019_fig-000.png`|W2957014459, p.3 附近|聚合物–陶瓷复合材料 taxonomy|同心圆分层；蓝色中心、青绿色类别、黄色标题，外围图标密集。|

## 2. 主图图型语法

- **众数图型**：分层 taxonomy、左右对照流程、结构—迁移双面板三类并列出现（W2922914774, W3037554945, W3202407852, W2957014459）。
- **布局方向**：左→右表示工艺或因果流程；上→下表示结构层级；双面板用 A/B 对照不同相或界面状态（W3037554945, W3202407852）。
- **模块舒适区间**：总览图 6–12 个模块；流程图 4–8 步；机理图 3–6 个标注实体、≤10 条连线（W2922914774, W3037554945, W2957014459）。
- **标注密度**：每模块 1–3 个词；关键数值放在箭头旁或表格中，不在节点内堆长句（W2922914774, W3202407852）。
- **通栏习惯**：taxonomy 与结构总览多用单栏宽度；复杂机理/对照图常用双栏通栏（W3202407852, W3037554945）。

## 3. 配色基准

范图采样的主色（近似 hex，仅用于新图配色起点）：

- 深蓝 `#1F66B3` / `#1F77B4`：中心主题或主体结构（W2957014459, W3037554945）。
- 青绿 `#2BC8A6` / `#32B5C4`：第二层类别或迁移通道（W2957014459, W3037554945）。
- 金黄 `#F4D03F` / `#EBC52A`：掺杂、活性颗粒或强调节点（W2922914774, W3202407852）。
- 淡灰 `#D7D7D7`、黑 `#111111`：骨架、边框和文字（W2922914774, W3202407852）。

**推荐的 LLZO 新图调色**：两种主题色（深蓝 + 青绿）加一个金黄强调色，背景白/浅灰；单图不超过 3 个高饱和色系。范图中的多色原子球只限结构渲染，不应扩展为彩虹泳道（W2922914774, W3037554945）。

### 图卡 A：工艺–结构–性能总览

`粉体合成 → 成形/烧结 → 晶粒/孔隙/晶界 → σLi+、活化能、临界电流 → 电池验证`；用 5 个等宽模块、单向箭头和一条底部指标带。证据锚点：W2922914774, W3202407852, W4381742819。

### 图卡 B：LLZO 相与输运机制

左侧画立方/四方晶格或 Li 位点，右侧画 Li1–Li2–Li3 路径；用同色球表示同一元素，金黄/青绿强调相变或瓶颈。证据锚点：W2922914774, W3037554945, W2604902219。

### 图卡 C：界面失效与修复矩阵

行 = 空气暴露、Li 润湿、枝晶、正极接触；列 = 失效机制、表征信号、处理策略、验证指标。每格 1–2 行短语，颜色仅在“问题/策略”两列作浅色区分。证据锚点：W2797994582, W3045616169, W4392914257。

中心仅放“LLZO garnet”，第二圈放掺杂/复合/薄膜三类，外围放代表工艺；最多两层同心圈，避免 W2957014459 范图中的过密图标。证据锚点：W2957014459, W3011658338。

- 图注先说“图展示的关系”，再说明颜色/箭头含义，最后给出来源或数据口径（W3202407852, W3037554945）。

# Supplemental writing notes for a WARN style bank

The style bank contains 30 records, but only 13 are classified as LLZO/garnet
core reviews.  I therefore used three readable exemplars to make the structural
choices explicit: Cao *et al.* (2019, LLZO modelling/preparation/doping), Kim
*et al.* (2020, garnet-electrolyte progress), and Puente *et al.* (2021,
garnet-type solid electrolytes).  These notes supplement, rather than replace,
`writing_style_cards.md`.

## Structural choices

* Open with the application constraint, define the LLZO phase/defect vocabulary,
  then move from composition and phase stability through powder synthesis,
  forming/densification, transport measurements, interfaces, and scale-up.
  This order keeps a processing variable adjacent to the structural readout it
  changes.
* Organize branch sections by material or process family before chronology.  A
  compact comparison table should state composition, thermal history, density,
  conductivity type/temperature, and interface or atmosphere notes together.
* Reserve a short limitations paragraph at the end of each branch.  Distinguish
  directly measured values from nominal-composition claims and from values that
  cannot be compared because geometry, density, or impedance fitting differs.

## Sentence and evidence patterns

Use a conclusion-first topic sentence, followed by mechanism, representative
conditions or ranges, and an explicit boundary.  Keep one factual claim per
sentence where possible and attach a citation immediately after the claim.
Paragraphs normally carry 3--8 citations; a table row carries at least one
source anchor.  Quantitative conductivity statements include temperature,
bulk/grain-boundary/total designation, relative density, and electrode geometry
when reported.

## Presentation and outlook

Use one restrained process--structure--transport overview figure and a separate
roadmap figure.  In the outlook, pair each bottleneck with a measurable
descriptor, a feasible experiment or model comparison, and its scope limit.
Conclude first with evidence-weighted findings, then with a prioritized set of
experiments that can discriminate the largest remaining uncertainties.

These notes were applied because the core-review count is below the style-bank
target; the supplementary exemplar set is still domain-relevant and all
reader-facing claims remain tied to `references.bib` entries.
